steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "5.33 | PATCH | Ensure 'Windows Error Reporting Service (WerSvc)' is set to 'Disabled'"
  when: win11cis_rule_5_33
  tags:
    - level2-high-security-sensitive-data-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_5.33
    - wersvc
  block:
    - name: "5.33 | AUDIT | Ensure 'Windows Error Reporting Service (WerSvc)' is set to 'Disabled' | Check to see if WerSvc service exists"
      ansible.windows.win_service_info:
        name: WerSvc
      register: discovered_5_33_wersvc_service_info

    - name: "5.33 | PATCH | Ensure 'Windows Error Reporting Service (WerSvc)' is set to 'Disabled' | Disable WerSvc service"
      when: discovered_5_33_wersvc_service_info.exists
      ansible.windows.win_service:
        name: WerSvc
        start_mode: disabled
        state: stopped
